stage1.impression: A tidy, warm, low-key CG interior that reads as a generic hotel-lobby bar, not a specific place: the two seated figures are smooth, faceless low-poly mannequins that motion blur does not disguise, the lit band under the ceiling reads as a flat sheet of orange corrugated plastic (signage), and the whole frame is one sepia-orange cast with no neutral concrete, steel or stone. No EARF product and no saturated accent colour is visible, so the frame has no hero; a design magazine would not publish this as a specific, well-made place.

blocking_9: No mannequin figures: either real-looking (scanned, clothed, properly motion-blurred) people or none, with signs of life carried by props (a coat on a stool, a record out of its sleeve, half-full glasses)

The acrylic band must read as thick cast fins with depth, glowing edges and a soft gradient, not as a flat uniform corrugated sheet (band region 130,98-918,168 currently uniform at lum_median 108.6 with fine moire)
Neutral materials must read neutral under warm light: the quartzite top, terrazzo and blackened steel need to separate from the oak instead of the whole frame sitting at r:g:b of about 2:1:0.5
Visible pools of light on the bar top and banquette with dark between them; the counter top now has no distinct pools
A visible hero: something of EARF's (the lantern's face with light through it, or a tinted Core/Hemisphere) carrying the frame's one saturated colour
The lantern's porch must read as an architectural oak sound lock, not as a pair of elevator doors

defects.what: Bartender/guest figure is a smooth low-poly mannequin with a sphere head; blur reads as smear, not motion
Second seated figure, same mannequin, reads as a placeholder
Acrylic band reads as flat orange corrugated plastic sheet, uniform glow, fine moire in the fins, two firefly specks near x 680-760
Pendant cord crosses the band as a hard dark line; the pendant shade is white and casts no visible pool on the counter
Lantern porch reads as flat veneer elevator doors with stretched, repeating grain; no thresholds, hardware or depth
Wall-washer hotspot on the baffle clips (clip 0.7% in 420,160-600,230) and is the brightest thing in the room
Quartzite bar top is a flat grey-brown slab with no veining, no reflections of the shelves and no pools from the 4 counter spots
Terrazzo counter front almost black (lum_median 15.2), chips read as noise
Right plaster wall a featureless dark brown plane (lum_median 13.9, range 45)
Tables are identical copies, flat black tops, no props on most; banquette upholstery reads as a dark box
Overall single orange-sepia cast (white balance 3200 K against 2700 K sources); nothing neutral, nothing saturated
Back-bar shelf lines are thin hard LED strips; bottles read as dark silhouettes with repeated shapes

changes.problem: The people are faceless mannequins and are the strongest single CG tell in the frame.

evidence.measured: Crop at 2x: sphere head, tube limbs, smooth matte surface; blur smears the silhouette but the primitive shapes remain

change.to: 0 figures; replace with signs of life: a wool coat over the second stool, a record out of its sleeve on the counter near x 150, two half-full glasses with condensation on the right tables (or, if people are required, clothed scanned figures with only the bartender's arms/torso in a 1/8 s blur)

changes.expected: The frame reads as a real empty-ish room just after service rather than a populated render.

changes.problem: The acrylic band glows as a uniform flat orange sheet, so the cast fins read as corrugated plastic signage.

evidence.measured: lum_median 108.6, r/g/b 176/95/40, flat along x; fine moire in the fins at 2x

change.setting: the lantern's band emission (and add a graze on the fins)
change.from: 0.1 behind Smoke fins, no edge light
change.to: 0.05 behind the fins plus a narrow 2400 K graze from the top edge so each fin's polished edge catches a highlight and the face falls off downward; render the band at full 2400x1600 to remove moire

changes.expected: Band median drops to about 70-90 with a visible vertical gradient and bright fin edges; it reads as thick cast acrylic, not a lit panel.

changes.problem: The whole frame sits under one orange cast, so oak, quartzite, terrazzo and steel all read as the same brown and nothing can be the single colour accent.

evidence.measured: r/g/b median 97/50/26 on the porch; 41/23/11 on the floor; 25/13/6 on the counter front

change.to: 2850 (tint -1.5 kept), and look AgX - Medium Contrast instead of Medium High

changes.expected: Stone and terrazzo shift toward warm grey, oak stays warm; blue channel rises roughly 25% relative to red on neutral surfaces.

changes.problem: The quartzite counter shows no pools of light even though it carries the four strongest spots, so the bar has no focus and no stone.

evidence.measured: lum_median 40.5, p95 77.2, x profile 60-65 falling to 16-19, no discrete pools

change.to: 4 x 90 W, 16 deg, aimed at the top's centreline so each lands as a separate oval pool; raise the quartzite's specular so the pools pick up the back-bar reflections

changes.expected: Distinct pools on the top with p95 above 120 and darker gaps between them.

changes.problem: The single downlight hotspot on the baffle clips and becomes the brightest thing in the room, pulling the eye to a blank slat wall.

change.setting: the baffle's graze / the wall downlight over the porch
change.from: one hot narrow spot above the porch, graze 0.3 W/m2
change.to: remove the single hotspot; raise the baffle's graze to 0.5 W/m2 from the floor (2400 K) so the slots read as depth from below

changes.expected: No clipping above the porch; the slotted baffle reads as a lit relief from bottom to top.

changes.problem: The porch's oak is a stretched, repeating flat veneer that reads as elevator doors.

evidence.measured: Crop at 2x: vertical streak grain repeats per panel, no pores, no edge bevel, constant tone; y falloff 137 to 31 is smooth like a gradient

change.to: rift-sawn oak at real scale (boards about 140 mm) with pore texture, slightly darker oiled tone, and a small edge highlight on the porch reveals; add a bronze pull and a leather threshold strip as small props

changes.expected: The porch reads as joinery with depth, grain at real scale, no repetition visible at 1:1.

changes.problem: The counter front and the right half of the room are near black, so the terrazzo and banquette are unreadable.

change.setting: the banquette spots and the fill
change.from: banquette 4 x 20 W, 30 deg; fill 0.05 W/m2
change.to: banquette 4 x 35 W, 30 deg aimed to wash the plaster above the leather; fill 0.08 W/m2; add a low toe-kick line under the counter overhang

changes.expected: Counter front and right wall reach a median of about 22-30 while staying low key.

changes.problem: Nothing in the frame carries a saturated EARF colour, so there is no hero and no brand.

evidence.measured: Every region measured has the same hue (r about 1.9x g, g about 1.8x b); no other hue anywhere

change.setting: the pendant (if it is a placed Hemisphere/Core) and the speakers' spots inside the lantern
change.from: white shade with no pool; pair spots 70 W hidden inside the lantern
change.to: light the tinted Hemisphere's glass from inside so its tint reads, and let the pair's light read through the lantern's slots/porch gap as a thin Ember line

changes.expected: One small area of saturated tint in the frame, the only colour that is not oak-brown.

out_of_scope.request: Put the Tropos pair or Mother EARF in view of this frame
out_of_scope.why: Products are fixed as placed inside the lantern; only the camera could reveal them, and the card fixes this frame's view down the counter

out_of_scope.request: Make the lantern's porch something other than a flat double-panel front (deeper reveal, offset door)
out_of_scope.why: The porch is fixed architecture; only its finish may change

out_of_scope.request: Change the band from fins to a deeper or edge-lit fixture
out_of_scope.why: The acrylic band's place and fins are fixed
